title: Anisotropic Higher-Order Semiregularity of Degenerate Generalized Equations
summary: We give a self-contained triangular formulation of anisotropic higher-order covering and inverse estimates for smooth mappings and generalized equations. For a $C^p$ mapping into a finite-dimensional target, an indexed target decomposition is fixed, the corresponding triangular factor condition is imposed, and a direction satisfying the associated triangular $p$-kernel condition is chosen.
